svg.title: Review a draft beside the source document
svg.desc: A schedule change mentions two jobs. Only one of their dates moved. Original note. The gate check moved to Friday. The pier check stays Tuesday. Draft. Ask for a short update inside the document. Verify. Compare both days before inserting the text.
svg.text: Review a draft beside the source document
A schedule change mentions two jobs. Only one of their dates moved.
The gate check moved to Friday. The pier check stays Tuesday.
Ask for a short update inside the document.
Compare both days before inserting the text.
